response.justification: Technically this candidate exceeds the stated requirements by a wide margin: 15+ years of fullstack work with TypeScript/Node, React, REST/GraphQL APIs, Docker/Kubernetes, AWS CDK, and current exposure to LLM/agentic tooling — all of which map directly onto the required and nice-to-have lists. He is also Berlin-based, which fits the high on-site expectation. The problem is fit rather than capability: the role is an entry-level individual contributor position, and a Staff/Senior engineer with founder experience is likely to be misaligned on compensation, scope, and long-term retention, and may find the growth path ("taking progressively more responsibility") redundant. Relational/PostgreSQL depth is also less evidenced than his NoSQL and niche-language (DLang) work. Worth a conversation only if the team is open to reframing the seniority band or if he can credibly explain the motivation for a step down.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node, React and API experience across many production systems
Strong DevOps/cloud coverage: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, plus LLM tooling
Berlin-based with proven craftsmanship focus (TDD, testing, mentoring, talks)
concerns: Significantly overqualified for an entry-level posting; retention and salary risk
PostgreSQL/relational depth less evident than MongoDB and NoSQL work
No Nest.js or renewable-energy/construction domain exposure; only basic German

key_factors.factor: Core stack match (TypeScript, React, REST, cloud)
